verdict.rationale: Supabase Storage documents built-in on-the-fly image optimization and resizing for any image in your buckets. Transform options work on signed and public URLs and are supported in the client libraries, and assets are served from a global CDN, so no self-run image pipeline is needed. missing for 10: availability on the free tier (resizing is limited to the Pro Plan and above), detail on the range of transformations beyond resize/optimize, independent or hands-on corroboration.
